UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences for pellet bag capacity and boiler consumption calculation method.

bagCapacityKg.description: Capacity of one pellet bag in kilograms (1 to 100).

calculationMethod.description: Consumption calculation method: FULL_REFILL (default, always fill hopper to full) or DIRECT_SUM.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings document was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings document was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PelletEntry.title: PelletEntry
PelletEntry.description: A single pellet loading/refill record into the boiler.

dateEpochDay.description: Calendar day of the refill as epoch day integer.

inputUnit.description: Unit originally used when logging the refill.

inputValue.description: Numeric amount entered in the selected unit.

bagCapacityKgAtEntry.description: Bag capacity in kg active when the entry was saved.

weightKg.description: Total resolved pellet weight in kilograms.

note.description: Optional note (e.g. pellet brand or boiler note), omitted when null/blank.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PelletStockBatch.title: PelletStockBatch
PelletStockBatch.description: A batch of owned/purchased pellet bags with its price for weighted-average consumption cost calculations.

bagsCount.description: Number of pellet bags in this stock batch.

bagCapacityKg.description: Weight of one bag in kilograms.

totalKg.description: Total pellet weight in kilograms for this batch.

pricePerBagPln.description: Price per single bag in PLN.

totalCostPln.description: Total cost of this batch in PLN.

purchaseDateEpochDay.description: Calendar day when this pellet batch was purchased as epoch day integer.

purchasePlace.description: Optional place or supplier where the pellet batch was purchased, omitted when null/blank.

pelletType.description: Optional type or wood species of pellet (e.g. Sosnowy, Dębowy), omitted when null/blank.

note.description: Optional supplier or pellet brand note, omitted when null/blank.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when batch was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when batch was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Per-user subcollection of pellet boiler refill entries.

/users/{userId}/stock_batches/{batchId}.description: Per-user subcollection of pellet stock purchases with quantity in bags and price.
